verdict.rationale: Finix documents API and Dashboard paths side by side for several core workflows: seller payouts, payout links, disputes (including evidence upload), seller onboarding, and webhook management. However, no documented claim says the API covers everything the UI does. Some features are described only through the Dashboard, such as manual card entry, notification settings under Settings > User, and the automated report types. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API equivalents for dashboard-only features (manual card entry, notification settings, reports), and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.
